segments.name: Wet Shave
segments.description: Manufactures and sells razors, blades, shaving gels and creams for men and women, plus private label shaving products.
segments.evidence: We manage our business in two operating segments: Wet Shave and Sun and Skin Care.

segments.name: Sun and Skin Care
segments.description: Sells sun care, men's and women's grooming, and personal wipe products under brands such as Banana Boat and Hawaiian Tropic.
segments.evidence: Sun and Skin Care products are sold under the Banana Boat, Hawaiian Tropic, Bulldog®, Jack Black®, Cremo® and Wet Ones brand names.

revenueModel.text: Retailers and distributors pay the company for its products, which are sold to consumers through retail locations worldwide.
revenueModel.evidence: We distribute our products to consumers through numerous retail locations worldwide, including mass merchandisers and warehouse clubs, food, drug and convenience stores, and military stores, and both traditional and modern trade customers outside of the United States.

changes.text: In 2026, the Feminine Care segment was sold to Essity and is now reported as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: The former Feminine Care segment's results are presented as discontinued operations on a retrospective basis for all fiscal years.
